Panel.Title: Blockworld Bridge
Panel.MapHint: Map control: click = walk · Shift+click = dig · Alt+click = attack (toggle with Shift+N)

GM.MapBound: This scene is a map: bottom-left ({x}, {z}), {size}×{size} blocks
GM.MapUnbound: This scene is not a map yet. Pick a character and a size.
GM.ViaBotChat: RCON is off, so commands are sent as bot chat. The bot needs operator rights.
GM.CornerHint: X, Z of the block at the map's bottom-left corner (south-west). Size comes from the picker above
GM.PosFromHint: Fill the fields below with the block the picked character stands in
GM.SpawnpointHint: The target respawns here after dying
GM.WorldSpawnHint: First-time joiners appear on this block (sets spawnRadius 0)
GM.TeleportHint: Y is the height of the feet. Characters who joined before come back where they left, so teleport them. Sending someone off the map needs a new map to see them.

View3D.Title: 3D view
View3D.NoViewer: The 3D view is not available. Your character must be online and the GM connected to the relay.
View3D.Help: Click: grab mouse · WASD move · Space jump · L-Shift sneak · L-Ctrl sprint · Left click hit/dig · Right click use · Esc release
View3D.Preparing: The GM is preparing the 3D files. This window opens when they are ready.

Notify.NoToken: Enter the relay token in module settings first.
Notify.NotYourBot: You can only control your own character.
Notify.NoGM: A GM must be online to reach Minecraft.
Notify.NoBotPosition: That character's position is not known yet.
Notify.NotMapScene: This scene is not a map scene. The GM sets it up from the panel.
Notify.BadUsername: Minecraft names are 3–16 letters, digits or _.
Notify.VisionSetupFailed: Could not turn on vision and fog for this scene. Enable them in the scene configuration.
Notify.RelayNotConnected: Not connected to the relay. Press 'Connect relay' in the GM panel.
Notify.AssetsUploading: Uploading 3D view files (block textures and models) to the Foundry data folder. This happens once.
Notify.AssetsFailed: Could not upload the 3D view files: {error}
Notify.NeedCorner: Enter whole numbers for the bottom-left X and Z.
Notify.NeedXYZ: Enter whole numbers for X, Y and Z (Y from -64 to 319).
Notify.PaddingStuck: The map scene has no padding but still does not start at the canvas corner (starts at {x}, {y}). The map is drawn on the scene; please report these numbers.

RelayUrl.Name: Relay address
RelayUrl.Hint: WebSocket address of the relay program (used only in the GM's browser)

RelayToken.Name: Relay token
RelayToken.Hint: The token from the relay's config.json. Stored only in this browser.

AutoConnect.Name: Auto-connect
AutoConnect.Hint: Connect to the relay when the world loads

MirrorChat.Name: Mirror Minecraft chat
MirrorChat.Hint: Post Minecraft chat, deaths and kicks to the Foundry chat log.

VisionRadius.Name: Character vision radius (blocks)
VisionRadius.Hint: How far each character sees on a map scene. Everything beyond is grey fog.

Avatar.Title: My character's 3D look
Avatar.Hint: In other players' 3D windows your character is a box in this colour with the illustration on the side it faces. 100% fits the front face; larger spills past the box.
Avatar.DragHint: Drag the picture in the preview to move it; scroll to resize.

View.Label: Cutaway
View.YHint: Floor level: Y of the block a character's feet are in
View.Walls: Turn walls into Foundry walls (blocks vision)
View.NeedY: A fixed floor needs a Y value

Hint.auto: Around characters under a roof the roof is cut away into a floor plan. If they are on different storeys, the upper one shows.
Hint.fixed: The whole map is cut at this floor into a floor plan. Change Y to switch storeys.
Hint.off: Plain top-down view: buildings show their roofs.
